property.title: Write footprint confined to destination polynomial
property.candidate_statement: The visible body writes only through r->coeffs[i]; no direct store targets b or any other storage in the shown function body.

supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The assignment writes through r only.
The interface distinguishes a mutable destination pointer from a const source pointer.

required_assumptions: The property is interpreted only over direct writes in the shown function body.
out_of_scope_boundaries: Does not rule out indirect effects on shared storage if r and b alias.
Does not assert that b's underlying object cannot change through aliasing with r.
property.uncertainty: The source pointer is const-qualified, but the snapshot does not include an aliasing contract that would make a stronger separation claim.
limitations: This is a direct frame property only; it does not speak to arithmetic correctness.

content.selection_reason: Selected after the LLM-authored candidate set was saved and post-classified. Selection is an experiment-control decision, not proof that the property is true.

effective_property_campaign.claim_boundary: Local selected claim only; uncatalogued status does not imply truth, novelty, or provability.
